authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W01-W03 accepted; W02 policy core available
defaults.mission: Objective/Task lifecycle, target-neutral Capability Registry, CapabilityPlan, GoalGraph DAG, bounded parallel scheduler, Fast/Governed lanes, ExecutionBudget, PlanTemplate/PlanBinding.

tasks.title: W04-00 Coordination / Ownership / Contract Freeze
actions: 1. Freeze control-core boundaries and target-neutral capability ownership.
2. Audit 69 legacy capability seeds and TOCA capability references as seed-only.
3. Define internal DAG/subwave dependencies and publication points required by W05/W07/W14/W15.
4. Enforce capability-first, not agent-first, planning.
tasks.ownership: W04 governance + Program Control-owned control/capability shared surfaces
tasks.forbidden: No runtime feature code; no executor/provider/device runtime.

tasks.title: W04-A Objective / Goal / Task Lifecycle
actions: 1. Define Objective/Goal/Task lifecycle contracts, states, transitions, cancellation and correlation.
2. Support deterministic supersession/terminal-state rules and evidence hooks.
3. Avoid embedding model/agent implementation details in lifecycle primitives.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/lifecycle/** plus W04-A-prefixed control tests; shared package/publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No W05 agent runtime; no scheduler, capability registry or W03 durability implementation.

tasks.title: W04-B Target-Neutral Capability Registry + CapabilityPlan
actions: 1. Create exactly one Capability Registry foundation.
2. Define capability metadata/binding: target kind, compatibility, availability/freshness, permissions/preconditions, risk/side-effect class, readback/evidence strategy.
3. Define CapabilityPlan that selects needed capabilities independent of agents/providers/devices.
4. Accept/reject/rename/decompose legacy/TOCA seeds explicitly with provenance.
5. Allow future DEVICE bindings without Android business logic and satisfy DP1 conditions.
tasks.ownership: packages/registries/src/capabilities/** + packages/control/src/capability-plan/** plus W04-B-prefixed tests; shared package/publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No second registry; no provider/device executor; capability availability/permission metadata is not authority; no W14 DeviceId/session/trust or W15 Android logic.

tasks.title: W04-F ExecutionBudget Contract
actions: 1. Define latency, cost, reasoning, tool-call and concurrency budgets.
2. Define budget propagation and exhaustion/degradation semantics.
3. Budgets may constrain strategy but may not weaken safety validation.
4. Expose fields needed by W17 telemetry and W18 optimizer.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/budget/** plus W04-F-prefixed tests; shared publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No cost optimization that skips mandatory validation; budget is not authority.

tasks.title: W04-C Goal Graph DAG / Dependency / Join Semantics
actions: 1. Implement GoalGraph DAG representation.
2. Define dependency edges, joins/fan-in, terminal/failure propagation and cancellation semantics.
3. Detect cycles and invalid dependency graphs.
4. Keep graph deterministic and bounded.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/goal-graph/** plus W04-C-prefixed tests; shared publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No model-driven implicit graph mutation without validation; no replacement for W03 durable workflow/timers/leases/replay.

tasks.title: W04-E Fast Lane / Governed Lane Resolver
actions: 1. Define lane eligibility using task/risk/reversibility/authority requirements.
2. Fast Lane may choose deterministic/template/low-cost paths but never bypass Policy/Authority/Executor.
3. Governed Lane handles complex/high-risk/approval-required work.
4. Produce explicit reason/evidence for lane selection.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/lanes/** plus W04-E-prefixed tests; shared publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: Lane selection is not authority; no W05 Intelligence Router and no W07 execution validation implementation.

tasks.title: W04-G Curated PlanTemplate / PlanBinding Foundation
actions: 1. Define curated reusable PlanTemplate and PlanBinding contracts.
2. Support known safe deterministic plans and template matching.
3. Store version/hash/provenance/compatibility and invalidation conditions.
4. Foundation only: learning/promotion remains W18.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/templates/** plus W04-G-prefixed tests; shared publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No adaptive self-promotion in W04; templates never create authority.

tasks.title: W04-D Parallel Scheduler / Bounded Concurrency / Fairness
actions: 1. Implement scheduler for independent DAG nodes.
2. Bound concurrency/fan-out and support cancellation/fairness/backpressure.
3. Define deterministic join behavior and resource budgets.
4. Prevent starvation and unbounded task explosion.
tasks.ownership: packages/control/src/scheduler/** plus W04-D-prefixed tests; shared publication surfaces remain Program Control-owned
tasks.forbidden: No provider/device execution; no duplicate W03 durable lease/timer/workflow implementation.

tasks.title: W04-H Integration / Performance / Contract Tests
actions: 1. Prove a mock goal selects capabilities, lane and budget.
2. Prove independent DAG nodes execute in parallel deterministically.
3. Prove known template path avoids frontier replanning.
4. Test cycle rejection, concurrency bounds, cancellation/fairness and target-neutral capability bindings.
tasks.ownership: W04 integration/benchmark/contract tests and W04 evidence/runbook only
tasks.forbidden: No new semantic runtime implementation and no external side effects.
